description:
from Create Enchantment Industry, you can over-enchant your gear past the vanilla level.

This is a bit complicated, but you need to pump

to a Blaze Burner that is holding an Enchanting Guide, and it will enchant a level above the Enchanting Guide's level. So you need to give the Guide a max level enchanting book, and then it can over-enchant through the supercharged Blaze Burner. You can then click on the Blaze Burner with the item you wish to enchant.

description.text: I recommend following the Enchantment Industry achievements near the end of the Create tab's advancements, or looking up a guide. This mod also lets you copy enchanting books, so it is worth taking a loot at outside of just over-enchanting items.

display.title: Supercharged Enchanting!
